title: Li-Li Undirected Multiple-Unicast Network Coding Conjecture
exact_target: Can coding ever improve on fractional routing for independent unicast messages in an undirected network with shared edge capacities?

sources.citation: Sirui Liu, Li Que, Zongpeng Li and Baochun Li, On the Multiple-Unicast Conjecture: Beyond Cut Metrics, arXiv:2608.06070v1 (2026).
